query: UPDATE twitch_session_chatters sc SET last_seen_at = agg.max_ts FROM ( SELECT cm.session_id, LOWER(NULLIF(cm.chatter_login, '')) AS chatter_login, cm.chatter_id, MAX(cm.message_ts) AS max_ts FROM twitch_chat_messages cm WHERE cm.session_id = ANY($1::bigint[]) AND (cm.chatter_login IS NULL OR cm.chatter_login = '' OR LOWER(cm.chatter_login) <> ALL($2::text[])) GROUP BY cm.session_id, LOWER(NULLIF(cm.chatter_login, '')), cm.chatter_id ) agg WHERE sc.session_id = agg.session_id AND agg.max_ts IS NOT NULL AND ( (agg.chatter_login IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(sc.chatter_login) = agg.chatter_login) OR (agg.chatter_login IS NULL AND agg.chatter_id IS NOT NULL AND sc.chatter_id = agg.chatter_id AND (sc.chatter_login IS NULL OR sc.chatter_login = '')) ) AND (sc.last_seen_at IS NULL OR sc.last_seen_at < agg.max_ts)
